manage.analytics.people.answers.empty: The registration form is empty or nobody has answered it yet
manage.analytics.people.dropoff.title: Approved with no attempt
manage.analytics.people.dropoff.subtitle: Who to remind about the event
manage.analytics.people.dropoff.hint: Approved participants who never submitted an answer. The opened tasks column shows whether they at least looked at a task.
manage.analytics.people.dropoff.search: Search by name, email or team
manage.analytics.people.dropoff.empty: Every approved participant has tried a task
manage.analytics.comms.stat.emailsHint: Emails the SMTP server accepted for sending. «With errors» are emails the server rejected or did not accept (a transport error); see «Mail journal» for details. Delivery to the mailbox and opens are not tracked.
manage.analytics.comms.stat.inAppHint: On-site notifications (the bell in the header) created for this event's participants. «With errors» are notifications that could not be created.
manage.analytics.comms.stat.readRateHint: The share of on-site notifications the recipient opened or marked read in the inbox. Reading is not tracked for emails.

manage.analytics.tasks.stats.label: Tasks summary
manage.analytics.tasks.stat.tasksHint: How many tasks are published and how many of them at least one team solved in the chosen period.
manage.analytics.tasks.stat.mismatchesHi: Tasks whose real solve rate does not match the declared difficulty. Only tasks tried by at least 3 teams are judged.
manage.analytics.tasks.stat.hintsHint: How many hints teams opened and how many points that cost.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.taskHint: Name, group and reward. Click to open the task details.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.difficultyHin: The difficulty the author declared in the catalog.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.attemptsHint: All answers teams sent to the task in the period, correct and wrong.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.triedHint: How many teams sent at least one answer.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.solvesHint: How many teams solved the task.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.rateHint: Solves divided by the teams that tried. Teams that only opened the task are not counted.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.calibrationHi: The declared difficulty against the real solve rate. A rating appears once at least 3 teams tried the task.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.sinceStartHin: Median time from the event start to the solve, among the teams that solved.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.sinceOpenHint: Median time from a team first opening the task to its solve. Counted only where the open was recorded.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.firstBloodHin: The team that solved the task first, and when. Hidden and not admitted teams are skipped.
manage.analytics.tasks.col.hintsHint: How many hints were opened and how many points were spent.
manage.analytics.tasks.calibration.title: Difficulty versus reality
manage.analytics.tasks.calibration.subti: Declared difficulty against the solve rate.
manage.analytics.tasks.calibration.hint: The band shows the solve rate expected for each difficulty. A dot is a task: green inside the band, yellow easier than declared, red harder. Tasks tried by fewer than 3 teams are not shown.
manage.analytics.tasks.calibration.empty: No task has been tried by a team yet.
manage.analytics.tasks.groups.title: Task groups
manage.analytics.tasks.groups.subtitle: Solve rate per group.
manage.analytics.tasks.groups.hint: Team-task pairs that were tried and how many of them were solved. A group's rate is the average over its tasks.
manage.analytics.tasks.groups.empty: The event has no groups yet.
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.title: Task
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.solvesOver: Solves as a running total and attempts per 5 minutes. The mouse wheel or the slider under the chart zooms.
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.hintEffect: Teams that opened a hint before solving (or never solved) against the rest. With a hint, time runs from the hint; without, from the first open or attempt.
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.failedHint: Teams that sent answers to this task and did not solve it.
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.failedEmpt: Every team that tried solved the task.
manage.analytics.tasks.detail.wrongHint: Answer texts are visible only to the event owner, moderators with write rights and platform administrators.
manage.analytics.progress.scores.title: Score dynamics
manage.analytics.progress.scores.hint: A team's score after every solve or hint, as on the results table. The leaders of the current ranking are shown, plus the teams you add.
manage.analytics.progress.scores.empty: There are no solves yet to draw a score.
manage.analytics.progress.matrix.title: Teams and tasks
manage.analytics.progress.matrix.hint: A row is a team in ranking order, a column is a task. A time means a solve, a number is the attempts without a solve, a dash means the team never touched the task.
manage.analytics.progress.matrix.empty: There are no teams or tasks yet.
manage.analytics.progress.heatmap.title: Activity by hour
manage.analytics.progress.heatmap.hint: How much a team did in an hour: attempts, task opens and solves. Darker is busier. The data comes from the 5-minute rollup and can lag by a few minutes.
manage.analytics.progress.heatmap.empty: No activity in this period yet.
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.title: Inactive teams
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.subti: Teams idle longer than the threshold.
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.hint: Teams that sent no answer and opened no task or hint for longer than the chosen time during the event. A team that has done nothing yet is idle since the start.
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.thres: How long a team must be idle to appear in the list.
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.notSt: The event has not started yet.
manage.analytics.progress.inactive.none: No team has been idle for longer than {threshold}.

manage.analytics.stands.stats.label: Stand key figures
manage.analytics.stands.stat.readyHint: How many teams have a ready stand out of all teams of the event. Not deployed means there is no stand yet (for example, the team is not admitted).
manage.analytics.stands.stat.failedHint: Teams whose stand is failed right now. A failure that was already resolved is not counted here; it is in Failures.
manage.analytics.stands.stat.deployHint: Time from creating a stand to its first ready state in the latest deployment. The median is less sensitive to a single slow stand. Only stands that became ready are counted.
manage.analytics.stands.stat.failuresHin: All stand and task lab failures of the event, from the status log. A repeated failure while the previous one is unresolved is not counted twice.
manage.analytics.stands.stat.recoveryHin: Time from a failure to the next ready state of the same stand or lab. Unresolved failures are not included.
manage.analytics.stands.stat.restartsHin: The highest restart count of every container in the telemetry, summed over teams. It shows unstable labs. Telemetry is kept for 90 days.
manage.analytics.stands.stat.vpnHint: Teams whose participants connected to the VPN in the chosen period. A session is a run of a client's handshakes with pauses of at most 3 minutes; a session with a single handshake lasts 0 s.
manage.analytics.stands.chart.title: Stand deploy time
manage.analytics.stands.chart.subtitle: By team, fastest first
manage.analytics.stands.chart.empty: No stand has become ready yet
manage.analytics.usage.unavailable: This event has no infrastructure, so there is no VPN or proxy usage
manage.analytics.usage.stats.label: Key usage figures
manage.analytics.usage.stat.onlineHint: Participants whose last WireGuard handshake is at most 3 minutes old. Only the handshake decides, not traffic: a connected participant without traffic is online too.
manage.analytics.usage.stat.connectedHin: Participants who connected to the VPN in the chosen period. A session starts with the first handshake after being offline and ends with the last one before a pause longer than 3 minutes.
manage.analytics.usage.stat.timeHint: The sum of the session lengths of all participants: from the first to the last handshake of each session. A session with a single handshake lasts 0 s.
manage.analytics.usage.stat.trafficHint: The volume that went through the VPN during the sessions of the period. A side figure: the online state is never derived from it.
manage.analytics.usage.stat.proxyHint: Participants who opened web tasks through the proxy. The counters accumulate over the whole event, the period does not affect them. Only requests and volume are counted, no addresses and no content.
manage.analytics.usage.detail.noLabs: Has not reached any task lab yet
manage.analytics.integrity.loadFailed: Could not load the solves to review
manage.analytics.integrity.noAccess: Only the event owner, moderators with edit rights and platform administrators can see this

manage.analytics.integrity.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} solves. Narrow the filters or the period.

manage.analytics.integrity.reason.no_acc: Solved without opening the task, its files or hints
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.no_lab: Solved a lab task without connecting to the VPN
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.too_fa: Solved faster than the level's threshold
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.first_: A hard task solved on the first attempt
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.shared: Wrong answers match those of other teams
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.burst: Several solves within a very short time
manage.analytics.integrity.reason.brute_: Many attempts within a short time
